corrections.normative_rule: For a seed, Q_OPERATING_POINT_SEED_PASS is true only when material continuous gain AND direction AND material locality advantage over concurrent DUP AND preservation all pass for that same seed. Q_STIFF_COUPLING_SEED is true only when material continuous gain AND DUP-like locality both pass for that same seed.
corrections.cohort_rule: Each cohort label requires at least two of exactly three seeds whose complete same-seed predicate is true. No component may be combined across seeds.

corrections.normative_rule: Retains locality means material locality advantage over the concurrent DUP arm under the frozen sham and matched-neutral L1 and MAP-flip criteria. It does not mean retention of SHAM-level locality.
corrections.zero_reference_rule: If either concurrent DUP L1 is zero, the corresponding relative advantage or coupling channel is unclassifiable and the seed fails the applicable locality conjunction.
